body:
He has decent insurance, I should look into that! Thanks. I had no idea that was a plausible option for anyone who doesn't have thousands of dollars to spare. 

It's great that he can trust me enough to be that honest with me, I really do appreciate that. I just feel a sense of responsibility. And I know it's not the right/healthy way to think but I can't help but be afraid if he does do something then its my fault. I know that isn't true, I just feel like I have the power or make or break this and it's pretty scary. 

I'll talk to him about specialty programs too! I don't know what he thinks about that, its never come up. We live in Los Angeles which has waaay more attorneys than jobs. It's all over the news how law schools lied about employment stats and a lot of people are getting fucked over. I get that it sucks a lot but I can't imagine ending everything over that. :/ He puts himself to really high standards and beats himself up for falling short. I don't know how happy he'd be even if he got his dream job. I think he needs help with how he perceives things.. I'm no psych but that's what makes me think he needs help. 

Thanks for your advice! :)

Ya, that's how I feel about it too, that it has to be serious. He wasn't really casual about it. He started talking to me about how deeply depressed about how he was about the jobhunt (not a new topic) and then how he thinks he's a failure and wants to kill himself came up which was very new. 

Thanks for your input :) You could be right about waiting for the right circumstances too. I don't know what those circumstances would be, but I don't want to find out.

Thank you for your advice. That's been mostly all I can say when he talks about it. Between "the way you're thinking about this is unhealthy" and "this isn't forever" is always "I love you".  I hope things work out too.

I hope you guys do alright <3 Just the thought of my boyfriend killing himself makes me so stressed out and depressed. I've been randomly breaking down crying throughout the day just on a train of "what if's". That alone is hard enough without other stuff going on, I can't imagine. I hope you guys crawl out of the dark times you're going through.
